title: Cyrus and the Silence
author: Jonah Reyes
blurb: Tamsin Thackeray, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
